title: Clean Sweep Bot
premise: A futuristic janitor robot glides around a neon floor vacuuming glowing dust credits while avoiding dangerous sludge patches.
interaction_model: Single-screen mouse-and-touch guided arcade play where the bot eases toward the cursor or finger, automatically pulling in nearby pickups within its suction radius.
objective: Collect as many dust credits as possible each run without touching sludge hazards, then spend the earned currency on permanent upgrades to improve future runs.
progression: Runs are endless until failure. Currency persists across runs and can be spent in a post-run shop on larger suction range and faster movement response, with increasing upgrade costs.
mood: Bright neon, polished, arcade-like, lightly tense, and playful
likely_audience: Casual arcade players, mobile-first web players, and players who enjoy simple dodge-and-collect loops with light upgrade progression.
confidence_notes: High confidence in the core loop because the full gameplay logic is contained in one HTML file.
High confidence that this is a survival-collection arcade game with persistent upgrades.
Moderate confidence in genre labeling because the category universe does not include a direct dodge-and-collect arcade label, so nearest-fit categories must be inferred.
recreation_prompt: Create a polished single-screen sci-fi arcade web game called "Clean Sweep Bot" where the player controls a hovering robot vacuum in a neon futuristic room using mouse movement or touch drag guidance. The bot should smoothly ease toward the pointer rather than move with keyboard controls, and it should display a visible suction radius around itself. During each run, glowing dust-credit pickups should drift around the arena and get pulled inward when they enter the suction field, awarding currency when fully collected. At the same time, pulsing muddy sludge hazards should sit on the floor and occasionally spawn over time; touching any sludge hazard should instantly end the run. The game loop should be endless score survival: collect as many dust credits as possible before failing, then show a stylish game-over screen that preserves the player’s total currency and allows spending it on permanent upgrades such as larger suction range and faster movement speed, with upgrade costs increasing each time. Present the game with a full-screen canvas, neon blue-green lighting, a futuristic glass-panel UI, a score HUD, animated positive and fail feedback popups, and upbeat arcade audio cues for start, pickup, purchase, blocked purchase, and game over. The overall feel should be fast, readable, mobile-safe, playful, and lightly tense, combining dodge hazards, vacuum collection, and between-run stat progression.
